text: The Patriots are looking to snap their Week 1 losing ways when they host the struggling Steelers on Sunday at Gillette Stadium, with some encouraging injury news on the running back front: TreVeyon Henderson, who sat out the opener with an ankle injury, declared himself "ready to go" for the matchup, though the offensive line did experience some movement with the signing of OL Xavier Newman-Johnson to the practice squad and the release of OL Jacob Rizy. However, the Patriots face a significant void at wide receiver with A.J. Brown sidelined for four weeks following a high ankle sprain suffered in Week 1, forcing other receivers to step up their production in what shapes up as a crucial divisional test. In a separate matter, owner Robert Kraft made news by confirming that Macklemore was removed as an opening act for Ed Sheeran's upcoming shows at Gillette Stadium due to what Kraft called a "history of antisemitic rhetoric and imagery," while the team will also celebrate the return of former All-Pro cornerback Stephon Gilmore, who will retire a Patriot during a Friday ceremony at Foxborough before the Sunday game.
